response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, extensive experience in developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, DLang libraries), and clear leadership in open-source and workshop initiatives, but lacks explicit evidence of people management, organizational change leadership, or mobile platform expertise — key requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, code generators)
Proven track record in open-source leadership and technical education (workshops, talks)
Broad technical stack across mobile, web, and systems programming with clear craftsmanship
concerns: No clear evidence of formal people management or team leadership experience
Limited visibility of mobile platform expertise despite role focus on mobile ecosystem
Missing demonstrated experience leading organizational change or strategic roadmap planning
